tier.caution.description: This message has some suspicious signs. Be careful.
tier.high_risk.description: This message is likely a scam. Do not act on it.
reason.requests_otp_pin: Asks for your PIN or one-time password
reason.urgency_language: Uses urgent language to pressure you
reason.impersonation: Pretends to be a bank or official organisation
reason.move_to_whatsapp: Asks you to move the conversation to WhatsApp
reason.asks_for_money: Asks you to send money or pay a fee
reason.fake_job_offer: Offers a job with suspicious conditions
reason.advance_fee: Asks for an upfront fee to release money
reason.romance_scam: Uses romantic language before asking for money
reason.lookalike_domain: Uses a web address that looks almost like a real one
reason.shortened_url: Hides the real web address with a short link
reason.phone_in_message: Contains a phone number asking you to call
reason.generic_greeting: Uses a generic greeting like 'Dear Customer'
reason.email_mismatch: Sender and reply address do not match
reason.display_name_spoof: Sender name looks like a real company but the address does not
txn_reason.new_recipient: You have not sent money to this person before
txn_reason.unusual_amount: This amount is much larger than your usual sends
txn_reason.round_large_amount: This is a large round-number amount
txn_reason.rapid_repeat_sends: You are sending to the same person multiple times quickly
txn_reason.after_risky_message: You recently received a high-risk scam message
txn_reason.new_country: You have not sent money to this country before
advice.do_not_share_pin: Never share your PIN or OTP with anyone — not even Mukuru staff.
advice.do_not_pay_upfront: Real jobs and prizes never require an upfront payment.
advice.verify_sender: Call the organisation back using the number on their official website.
advice.do_not_click_link: Do not click the link. Type the website address yourself.
advice.pause_and_confirm: Pause this transfer and confirm the recipient's identity first.
advice.report_scam: Report this to your bank or SABRIC (South African Banking Risk Information Centre).
advice.trust_your_instincts: If it feels wrong, stop. Talk to someone you trust before continuing.
advice.block_and_report: Block this sender and mark the message as spam.
advice.check_url: Check the web address carefully — scammers use addresses that look almost right.

demo.sample_scams.fake_job: Congratulations! You've been selected for a work-from-home job paying R5000/week. To activate your position, pay a R500 registration fee via EFT to account 1234567. WhatsApp +27600000001 to confirm.
demo.sample_scams.phishing: ABSA BANK: Your account has been suspended. Verify now at www.absa-secure-login.co to avoid permanent closure.
demo.sample_scams.romance: My darling, I am stuck at customs in Dubai. They are holding my luggage and need $300 to release it. I will pay you back double when I arrive. Please help me, I love you.
demo.sample_scams.advance_fee: Dear Beneficiary, you have been selected to receive $1.5 million from the estate of Dr. James Okafor. To release funds, you must first pay a processing fee of $200.
demo.sample_scams.impersonation: SARS NOTICE: You have an outstanding tax refund of R3,200. Claim it at www.sars-refund-portal.net within 24 hours or it will be forfeited.
